question: In Melanoma trials, bucket overall follow-up months into <12, 12–23, or ≥24.
generated_sql:
SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN "Follow-up duration for primary endpoint(s) in months | Overall" < 12 THEN '<12'
        WHEN "Follow-up duration for primary endpoint(s) in months | Overall" >= 12 AND "Follow-up duration for primary endpoint(s) in months | Overall" < 24 THEN '12–23'
        WHEN "Follow-up duration for primary endpoint(s) in months | Overall" >= 24 THEN '>=24'
        ELSE 'Unknown'
    END AS "Follow-up Duration Bucket",
    COUNT(*)
FROM compat.clinical_trials
WHERE "Cancer type" = 'Melanoma'
GROUP BY "Follow-up Duration Bucket"
